## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#14`
- **Variant Name**: `FeeRateTooHigh`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)

## Trigger Conditions
This error is returned by the contract when:
- `FeeRateTooHigh` validation fails during entrypoint invocation.


---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Set the fee rate to at most MAX_FEE_BPS (1,000 bps = 10%) when calling set_fee_bps.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_set_fee_bps(&f.governor, &(MAX_FEE_BPS + 1)));
```
